name: factual_accuracy
description: The response contains the correct factual information (e.g. correct room, time, author, copies).

name: tool_usage
description: The agent called the appropriate tool(s) rather than answering from parametric memory.

name: helpfulness
description: The response is actionable and gives the student what they need to proceed.

name: conciseness
description: The response is brief and to the point without unnecessary filler.
